full_prompt_en: A square cinematic science-fiction image shows a young woman in dark tactical clothing looking right through rain toward blurred neon light. The background is an indistinct urban night, mostly deep teal and black. In the upper right, broad white and soft pink luminous rectangles float out of focus, with smaller round lights descending toward the lower middle. Fine vertical rain streaks pass across the frame and soften the distance. The woman fills the left and central foreground from the shoulder upward, shown in right-facing profile. Short dark hair sits in a loose bob, with damp strands against the cheek and neck. A cool highlight catches her visible eye, nose bridge, and parted lips; her expression is alert and quietly troubled. Her ear and the back of her head remain in deep shadow. A high black collar and hard dark shoulder panel frame the lower face. Their surfaces appear wet or polished in small areas, reflecting blue-white and faint red light along seams and curved edges. Most details of the clothing disappear into the nearly black lower left, while the glossy shoulder keeps enough reflected texture to be readable. The strongest illumination comes from the right-front neon and overhead city lights, leaving the far side of the head dark and tracing a narrow cool line along the facial profile. The shallow focus separates the sharp face from the fully dissolved signage and distant passersby-like shapes. No text in the background is readable. The overall composition is tense and intimate, using restrained blue-black color, rain, and scattered pink-white bokeh to hold one still gaze against a restless night city.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形电影感科幻图像呈现一位年轻女子穿深色战术服，在雨中朝右望向模糊霓虹光。背景是难以辨认的城市夜景，大部分为深青绿和黑色。右上方，宽阔的白光与柔粉色发亮矩形在失焦中浮现，较小圆灯一路向画面下部中央延伸。细长竖向雨丝穿过画幅，使远处更柔。女子从肩部向上填满左侧和中央前景，以朝右的侧面入画。深色短发松散成齐耳长度，湿发丝贴在脸颊与颈边。冷光落在可见的眼睛、鼻梁和微张嘴唇上；神情警觉又安静不安。耳朵与后脑留在深影里。高黑领与坚硬深色肩甲围住下半张脸。表面部分湿亮或经过抛光，缝线与弯曲边缘反射蓝白及微弱红光。衣服大部分细节消失在近黑的左下方，有光泽的肩部则保留足够反光肌理而可辨。最强照明来自右前方霓虹和头顶城市灯光，让头部远侧保持黑暗，并沿侧面轮廓描出狭窄冷光线。浅景深把清晰面庞同完全溶解的标牌及远处类似路人的形体分开。背景中没有可读文字。整体构图紧张而亲密，用克制蓝黑色彩、雨丝和散落粉白散景，让一道静止目光面对躁动夜城。
style_prompt_en: The cinematic science-fiction treatment is built from deep blue-black and teal shadows pierced by a few pale cyan, white, and muted magenta lights. Focus is selective: one near plane holds fine reflective detail while distance melts into broad rectangular glow and circular bokeh. Rain appears as thin vertical streaks, adding texture without filling every dark area. Glossy and matte passages alternate, so small highlights reveal curved structure within an otherwise obscured mass. Light comes from multiple distant points but remains directionally concentrated on one side, leaving the opposite side nearly black. The composition favors a large dark off-center form against a narrower luminous gap. Color is restrained and cool, with pink accents serving as brief counterpoints rather than dominating the image. Fine grain and haze soften transitions while crisp focal edges preserve intimacy. The overall effect is nocturnal, watchful, and emotionally taut, with reflective materials and shallow depth shaping the atmosphere.
style_prompt_zh: 这种电影感科幻处理建立在深蓝黑与青绿色阴影上，少数浅青、白和低饱和洋红光从中穿透。聚焦有选择性：近处一层保留细致反光，远处则溶成宽阔矩形辉光与圆形散景。雨表现为细长竖向线痕，增加肌理，却不填满所有暗区。光泽与哑光段落交替，使小亮点从原本被遮蔽的大形中显出弯曲结构。光来自几个遥远点位，但集中照亮一侧，另一侧几乎全黑。构图偏好偏离中心的深色大形与较窄的明亮空隙相对。色彩克制且偏冷，粉色只作为短暂对位重音，而不主导图像。细颗粒和雾气柔化过渡，清晰焦点边缘则保留亲密感。整体效果夜间、警觉且情绪紧绷，由反光材料与浅景深塑造空气。
theme_en: A young woman in dark armor watching neon lights through rain
theme_zh: 身穿深色护甲的年轻女子在雨中望向霓虹灯光
name: Ghost In The Shell
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
